title: Mouse Squeaks.wav
author: shyguy014
description: One morning I woke up and found I had a mouse/rat trapped, but still alive. It was making squeaking sounds, so I recorded them, edited out the noise as much as I knew how to, and amplified the whole thing. The mouse was disposed of shortly afterward. This sound was recorded with a Zoom H4N Recorder in Stereo, in .Wav format. Please feel free to use "Mouse Squeaks" as you see fit.
